# Malachi

> Open source reimplementation of LinkedIn's NorthGuard, written in Elixir on Erlang/OTP 28, MIT licensed. Clients speak topics, keys and opaque cursors; ranges split and merge underneath; a write is acknowledged once a majority of copies have fsynced it.

Malachi is in active development and not production-ready. The quickstart below runs plaintext on localhost only; configure TLS before serving real traffic.

```
# Set your own admin password (12 characters or more) in the shell first:
# export MALACHI_ADMIN_PASS='your own password'
docker run \
  -p 127.0.0.1:4040:4040 \
  -p 127.0.0.1:4041:4041 \
  -e MALACHI_ADMIN_PASS \
  -e MALACHI_REQUIRE_TLS=false \
  hectorcardoso/malachi:latest
```

Malachi listens on 4040 and the dashboard on 4041.
